init.title: Autarco Local Settings Center
init.description: Live inverter settings grouped by access level. v0.5.1 is a safe preview: physical Modbus writes remain locked until installer review and write-register validation are complete.

menu_option_descriptions.standard_settings: Normal end-user settings that are candidates for direct editing after validation.
menu_option_descriptions.expert_settings: Advanced battery and operating settings that will require explicit confirmation.
menu_option_descriptions.installer_settings: Installer/system settings remain visible but read-only.
menu_option_descriptions.safety_rules: Shows enforced relationships such as Reserve SOC ≥ Minimum battery SOC.

standard_settings.title: 🟢 Standard settings
standard_settings.description: Current live values. Physical writes are currently **{write_status}**. [Autarco LH-MII documentation](https://www.autarco.com/fileadmin/user_upload/downloads/Inverters/Hybrid_Inverters/LH-MII/IM-S2.LH-MII-EN-V1.4.pdf)

data_description.setting_reserve_soc: Battery reserve target. Future writes will always enforce Reserve SOC ≥ Minimum battery SOC. See the Autarco LH-MII battery/storage settings documentation.
data_description.setting_self_use_mode: Uses PV first for the home and battery before exporting surplus energy.
data_description.setting_time_of_use_mode: Enables scheduled charge/discharge behavior using the configured time slots.
data_description.setting_reserve_battery_mode: Enables use of the configured Reserve SOC as a battery reserve behavior.
data_description.setting_feed_in_priority_mode: Changes the operating priority toward grid feed-in where supported.

expert_settings.title: 🟡 Expert settings
expert_settings.description: Advanced settings. Physical writes are currently **{write_status}**. These settings will require validation, warning and confirmation before v0.6 enables selected writes. [Autarco LH-MII documentation](https://www.autarco.com/fileadmin/user_upload/downloads/Inverters/Hybrid_Inverters/LH-MII/IM-S2.LH-MII-EN-V1.4.pdf)

data_description.setting_overdischarge_soc: Normal lower SOC limit for battery discharge. Raising it keeps more reserve; lowering it increases usable capacity. A future change may never make Reserve SOC lower than this value.
data_description.setting_force_charge_soc: Low-SOC protection threshold associated with forced charging behavior. Treat as an expert battery-protection setting.
data_description.setting_force_charge_power_limit: Power limit used for force-charge behavior. Incorrect values can change how aggressively the battery is recovered.
data_description.setting_off_grid_mode: Controls off-grid operation. Only use on an installation that is electrically suitable for off-grid operation and its physical switching arrangement.
data_description.setting_allow_grid_charge: Allows charging from the electricity grid where the active operating mode permits it.
data_description.setting_off_grid_overdischarge_soc: Minimum SOC used during off-grid operation. Higher values keep more emergency reserve.
data_description.setting_time_charge_current: Battery charge current used by scheduled Time-of-Use operation.
data_description.setting_time_discharge_current: Battery discharge current used by scheduled Time-of-Use operation.

installer_settings.title: 🔴 Installer / system settings
installer_settings.description: These values remain visible for diagnosis and installer review. They are not intended for end-user writes. Items marked 'Not mapped yet' remain deliberately unmapped rather than guessing a register.

data_description.setting_overcharge_soc: Battery upper SOC protection setting. Kept installer/read-only.
data_description.installer_grid_standard: Grid-code selection must match the local grid requirements and installation approval.
data_description.installer_grid_voltage_limits: Protection thresholds for grid voltage. Installer/system only.
data_description.installer_grid_frequency_limits: Protection thresholds for grid frequency. Installer/system only.
data_description.installer_anti_islanding: Safety and anti-islanding protection. Never exposed as an end-user write.
data_description.installer_meter_type: Selects the installed energy meter hardware. Wrong settings can invalidate power-flow measurements.
data_description.installer_meter_function: Defines the meter role/position in the installation.
data_description.installer_ct_direction: Defines current-transformer direction/configuration and can invert measured power flow if wrong.
data_description.installer_battery_select: Selects the supported battery/BMS profile. Wrong selection can break battery communication; exact register still needs validation.
data_description.installer_battery_communication: Battery CAN/RS485 communication configuration. Installer only.
data_description.installer_modbus_address: Communication parameters. Changing these can make Autarco Local lose access to the inverter.

safety_rules.title: Settings safety rules
safety_rules.description: These rules are enforced in backend validation and will also apply to future entity/service writes, not only to this menu.

data_description.safety_reserve_soc: Reserve SOC may never be lower than Minimum battery SOC.
data_description.safety_minimum_soc: If Minimum battery SOC is raised, Reserve SOC must remain equal to or above it.
data_description.safety_soc_relationship: Backend invariant: Reserve SOC ≥ Minimum battery SOC.
data_description.safety_write_status: v0.5.1 keeps physical Modbus writes locked pending installer review and write-register validation.
